text:
marta-partners: Heads-up 1: we're kicking off the three-cloud marketplace onboarding (AWS / GCP / Azure). Main open items: publisher IAM/service account templates, KMS ownership decision, SKU trial mapping, branding assets, and publish network requirements. Can each owner confirm?

eli-legal: I can take the contract/EULA pieces. Quick position: require customer-managed KMS for any offer that processes customer PII or stores customer data. For standard hosted demos we can permit marketplace-managed keys but add a clear data-responsibility clause. I'll draft clauses and post a sample EULA excerpt.

ash-product: Packaging constraints from product: must support a 14-day free trial SKU and a paid SKU. SKU CSV needs fields: sku_id, sku_name, billing_term, trial_days, seats_included, list_price_usd. Images: hero 1600x600, three screenshots 1200x800, and a short 150-char description. Also need a 1-line tagline.

rohan-eng: Tech checklist: 
- AWS: two IAM roles (publisher-assume for marketplace, publisher-deploy for AMI publishing). Provide example trust policy (sts:AssumeRole) and least-priv permissions.
- GCP: service account + roles: compute.instanceAdmin, storage.objectViewer, and cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for KMS operations.
- Azure: service principal with contributor scope to the publish subscription + KeyVault access.
I'll add Terraform module under infra/marketplace/publisher-roles and a README.

nina-ops: Ops notes: publishing endpoint must accept inbound webhook callbacks from marketplace IPs. If customers use IP allowlisting, we need to provide the list. Also ensure our staging publish job runs in the staging VPC with outbound access to provider endpoints. I'll validate port 443 and TLS ciphers.

marta-partners: @eli-legal can you confirm localization needs? We'll launch EN + FR + DE for EU/NA first. APAC localizations later.

eli-legal: Confirmed EN/FR/DE for launch. Recommend we add EN-JP as optional for a later pilot.

marketplace-bot: New checklist created: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/onboard/4160001234. Steps: 1) EULA & KMS policy, 2) IAM templates PR, 3) assets uploaded, 4) SKU CSV, 5) staging publish test, 6) legal signoff, 7) production publish.

rohan-eng: Pushed initial terraform module to https://git.redwood/infra/marketplace/publisher-roles/tree/feature/4160001234. Included AWS trust policy example: ```{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"Service": "marketplace.amazonaws.com"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}``` and a note about required S3 naming for AMI assets.

ash-product: Uploaded assets to Drive: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/4160001234 (hero.png, screenshot-1.png, screenshot-2.png, screenshot-3.png). Also dropped sample SKU CSV at that location.

nina-ops: I'll run validation: asset dimensions, file sizes (<5MB each), and run the publish simulator against staging tomorrow 09:30 PT. Booking a 30m sync with infra.

marta-partners: I'll collate deliverables and send a 30m handoff invite for 10:00 PT. If anyone hits blockers post here and I'll escalate. Thanks! :rocket:
